content.title: This Water Stock Is Dehydrated. What Could Bring It Back.
content.summary: Primo Brands  the bottled water company that produces Poland Springs and Pure Life, is looking dehydrated.  While critics wonder if the country’s leading water vendor can regain lost costumers due to operational issues earlier this year, its boosters believe the stock could be revived soon thanks to the water market’s strong growth.  Formed through a merger of Primo Water and BlueTriton Brands last November, the company’s comparable net sales in the second quarter are down 2.5% from a year ago.
